sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin, and I'm Mark Ronson, and welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 大家好，我是本杰明·普兰，我是马克·朗森，欢迎收听《重构者》，这是一档专注于设计之美及其背后文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl, every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you,
sentences.zh: 即便是在我还在夜店打碟的黑胶唱片时代，你每天晚上都要带着300件你最珍视的宝贝去工作，

sentences.en: and you turned a DJ booth into this, like, living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 然后把DJ台变成一个鲜活的、快闪式的博物馆，陈列着那些精美的、有50年历史的艺术品。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听爱彼出品的《重构者》吧。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今天。

sentences.en: One week ago, President Trump was accused of being a tool of Vladimir Putin,
sentences.zh: 一周前，特朗普总统还被指责是弗拉基米尔·普京的傀儡，

sentences.en: filled with admiration for the Russian leader, defending him from critics, and eager to become his ally.
sentences.zh: 对他充满钦佩，为他辩护，并渴望成为他的盟友。

sentences.en: Now, just one week later, Trump says the relationship is at an all-time low.
sentences.zh: 而现在，仅仅一周后，特朗普就表示两国关系已降至历史最低点。

sentences.en: What is going on with the U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国和俄罗斯之间到底发生了什么？

sentences.en: and Russia?
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯之间到底发生了什么？

sentences.en: It's Thursday, April 13th.
sentences.zh: 今天是4月13日，星期四。

sentences.en: Good evening.
sentences.zh: 晚上好。

sentences.en: We just came from a productive meeting of about two hours with President Putin.
sentences.zh: 我们刚刚结束了与普京总统长达两个小时的富有成效的会谈。

sentences.en: We frankly discussed the current state of U.S.-Russia relations.
sentences.zh: 我们坦诚地讨论了美俄关系的现状。

sentences.en: There is a low level of trust between our two countries.
sentences.zh: 我们两国之间的互信水平很低。

sentences.en: The world's two foremost nuclear powers cannot have this kind of relationship.
sentences.zh: 作为世界上最重要的两个核大国，不应维持这种关系。

sentences.en: Secretary of State Rex Tillerson is in Moscow at a historically tense moment for the two countries.
sentences.zh: 国务卿雷克斯·蒂勒森正处于两国关系历史上极其紧张的时刻，身处莫斯科。

sentences.en: So is my colleague, David Sanger.
sentences.zh: 我的同事大卫·桑格也在那里。

sentences.en: It's been a long day.
sentences.zh: 这是漫长的一天。

sentences.en: We got in around four in the morning and slept for a couple of hours.
sentences.zh: 我们凌晨四点左右到达，只睡了几个小时。

sentences.en: Then the day has been basically flat out since about 9 a.m.
sentences.zh: 从早上9点开始，这一天基本上就没停过，

sentences.en: and we're no place close to done.
sentences.zh: 而且我们离结束还远着呢。

sentences.en: So, David, I want you to walk me through this pretty extraordinary day.
sentences.zh: 那么，大卫，我想请你带我回顾一下这极其不平凡的一天。

sentences.en: It seems to start with it not being at all clear whether Vladimir Putin is going to meet with Rex Tillerson.
sentences.zh: 这一天似乎从弗拉基米尔·普京是否会见雷克斯·蒂勒森的不确定性开始。

sentences.en: Today was a day of sort of power games that are not unusual in the world of diplomacy, but are particularly common when you're dealing with Vladimir Putin.
sentences.zh: 今天上演了一场外交界并不罕见，但在与弗拉基米尔·普京打交道时尤为常见的权力游戏。

sentences.en: Every time a secretary of state and sometimes even President Obama would be working toward a meeting with President Putin,
sentences.zh: 每当国务卿，甚至有时是奥巴马总统试图安排与普京总统会面时，

sentences.en: there was always this sort of dangling for a while to determine whether the meeting would happen and if so at what time
sentences.zh: 总会有一段时间的悬而未决，来确定会面是否会发生，如果发生，时间定在何时，

sentences.en: and to make it clear that it was going to happen on Putin's schedule, not on anybody else's.
sentences.zh: 并明确表示一切都要按照普京的时间表来，而不是其他人的。

sentences.en: So he literally wouldn't set the time?
sentences.zh: 所以他真的就不定时间吗？

sentences.en: He would sort of leave things in limbo?
sentences.zh: 他会把事情悬置起来？

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And Mr. Tillerson today did not head over to the Kremlin until sort of 6 in the evening.
sentences.zh: 而蒂勒森先生今天直到傍晚6点左右才前往克里姆林宫。

sentences.en: The Kremlin hadn't made it clear whether they would meet with him at all
sentences.zh: 克里姆林宫之前并没有明确表示是否会见他，

sentences.en: and suggested that it sort of depended on how well he did with the foreign minister who he was meeting, Sergei Lavrov.
sentences.zh: 并暗示这取决于他与他会见的俄罗斯外交部长谢尔盖·拉夫罗夫谈得如何。

sentences.en: And David, are you being shuttled around not knowing when or if a meeting will happen?
sentences.zh: 大卫，你们是不是在不知道何时会面、甚至是否会面的情况下被到处转运？

sentences.en: Is that your day?
sentences.zh: 这就是你们的一天吗？

sentences.en: We were given a time for a news conference that we knew was completely fictional and it turned out we were right.
sentences.zh: 我们被告知了一个新闻发布会的时间，但我们知道那是完全虚构的，事实证明我们是对的。

sentences.en: And by the end of the day, the small motorcade of vans from the U.S.
sentences.zh: 到了一天结束时，美国大使馆原本应该来接我们的那几辆小货车，

sentences.en: embassy that was supposed to pick us up after couldn't even get through the Russian guards.
sentences.zh: 甚至无法通过俄罗斯警卫的封锁。

sentences.en: So we were all out on a freezing street calling Ubers.
sentences.zh: 所以我们只能站在寒风凛冽的街头叫优步。

sentences.en: And your Uber app from Washington works in Moscow.
sentences.zh: 而且你在华盛顿用的优步应用在莫斯科也能用。

sentences.en: So it feels, David, like Tillerson arrived in Russia at a moment of significant tension in this relationship between the Putin administration and the Trump administration.
sentences.zh: 大卫，感觉蒂勒森是在普京政府与特朗普政府关系极度紧张的时刻抵达俄罗斯的。

sentences.en: And I want you to just talk a little bit about that.
sentences.zh: 我想请你谈谈这一点。

sentences.en: Well, we're at what Mr. Tillerson himself referred to today as a low point in relations.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们正处于蒂勒森先生今天所说的关系低谷。

sentences.en: And he was absolutely accurate in saying that.
sentences.zh: 他说得完全准确。

sentences.en: We are also at a point where the United States fears the revival of a Cold War.
sentences.zh: 我们现在也处于美国担心冷战复辟的时刻。

sentences.en: Now, I don't think it's going to be a Cold War of the kind that we had the last time because Russia today is a fraction of the power of the old Soviet Union.
sentences.zh: 不过，我不认为这会是像上次那样的冷战，因为今天的俄罗斯实力仅为前苏联的一小部分。

sentences.en: And fortunately, we are no longer pointing more than 10 or 12,000 or in some cases, many more thousand nuclear weapons at each other.
sentences.zh: 幸运的是，我们不再像过去那样，有超过一万甚至一万两千枚核弹头瞄准对方。

sentences.en: We're down to 1,500 each.
sentences.zh: 现在我们双方各剩下1500枚。

sentences.en: That's plenty.
sentences.zh: 这已经足够多了。

sentences.en: But at the same time, you have seen in what Putin has done in Syria, a situation in which
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，看看普京在叙利亚的所作所为，你会发现，

sentences.en: Putin himself has said, I am not ceding the Middle East to American influence.
sentences.zh: 普京本人已经说过，我不会把中东拱手让给美国的影响力。

sentences.en: I'm going to be a player as well.
sentences.zh: 我也要成为其中的参与者。

sentences.en: And that's basically what the battle with Tillerson in this first meeting is all about.
sentences.zh: 这基本上就是蒂勒森在这次首次会晤中面临的博弈核心。

sentences.en: And this is the first encounter, face-to-face encounter, between a senior member of the
sentences.zh: 这是特朗普政府的高级成员与弗拉基米尔·普京之间的首次面对面接触。

sentences.en: Trump administration and Vladimir Putin.
sentences.zh: 特朗普政府与弗拉基米尔·普京之间的首次面对面接触。

sentences.en: And it's not the encounter we had expected.
sentences.zh: 但这并不是我们预期的那种接触。

sentences.en: We had expected one that would be based on the Trump concept that Russia was the one country with whom he could rebuild a relationship.
sentences.zh: 我们原本预期会基于特朗普的理念，即俄罗斯是他可以重建关系的唯一国家。

sentences.en: I mean, even a week ago, this looked all extraordinarily different.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，就在一周前，情况看起来还完全不同。

sentences.en: So how and why did things flip so dramatically and so fast?
sentences.zh: 那么，事情是如何如此剧烈且迅速地发生逆转的呢？

sentences.en: It's a very good question.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常好的问题。

sentences.en: And it flipped in part, I think, because President Trump reacted understandably to those very emotional pictures of kids dying of sarin gas.
sentences.zh: 我认为部分原因是特朗普总统对那些孩子们死于沙林毒气的感人画面做出了可以理解的反应。

sentences.en: I mean, do you think that Trump genuinely believed that Russia could make for a good ally to the
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你认为特朗普真的相信俄罗斯可以成为美国的好盟友，

sentences.en: United States and then Syria happened?
sentences.zh: 然后叙利亚事件就发生了吗？

sentences.en: I think that Donald Trump sees the world in a very transactional way, which is not surprising
sentences.zh: 我认为唐纳德·特朗普以一种非常交易化的方式看待世界，这对于一个房地产开发商来说并不奇怪，

sentences.en: for somebody who had been a real estate developer, where you move from one transaction to another and they're not all that related.
sentences.zh: 因为你从一笔交易转到另一笔交易，而它们之间并没有太大的关联。

sentences.en: And suddenly, in a series of transactions, he's been shocked to discover how the Russians act around the world.
sentences.zh: 突然间，在一系列交易中，他震惊地发现俄罗斯人在世界各地的行径。

sentences.en: And he's come to some fairly obvious conclusions about how you have to go respond to that.
sentences.zh: 他得出了一些相当明显的结论，关于你必须如何去应对这些。

sentences.en: What worries me here is, just from watching Mr. Tillerson operate, and I think he's a fairly
sentences.zh: 让我担心的是，仅仅从观察蒂勒森先生的操作来看，我认为他是一个相当谨慎的操作者，

sentences.en: cautious operator, is that we've gone from a president, President Obama, who had a long-term plan
sentences.zh: 我们从一位对俄罗斯有长期计划，但却不愿在叙利亚等地介入并反击他们的总统奥巴马，

sentences.en: for Russia, but was not willing to go step in and knock them back a bit in a place like Syria,
sentences.zh: 转变为一位唐纳德·特朗普，他非常愿意在叙利亚等地进行反击，但目前还没有任何长期计划。

sentences.en: to a president in Donald Trump, who was more than willing to go out and knock them back in a place like Syria, but who does not yet have a long-term plan of any kind.
sentences.zh: 转变为一位唐纳德·特朗普，他非常愿意在叙利亚等地进行反击，但目前还没有任何长期计划。

sentences.en: So, a lot of building tension came to a head just in the last couple of days because the
sentences.zh: 所以，在过去几天里，大量的紧张局势集中爆发，因为特朗普政府指责俄罗斯，

sentences.en: Trump administration accused Russia, not just of being in Syria and being a kind of a nettlesome ally, but of covering up Syria's role in these chemical attacks.
sentences.zh: 不仅是在叙利亚扮演了一个令人头疼的盟友角色，而且还在掩盖叙利亚在这些化学武器袭击中的作用。

sentences.en: How did all of that get dealt with today in these meetings?
sentences.zh: 今天在这些会议上是如何处理所有这些问题的？

sentences.en: It got dealt with in these meetings, Michael, by a determination by each side that they were going to stick to their accounting of the facts.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，这些会议的处理方式是，双方都决定坚持各自对事实的陈述。

sentences.en: And what was remarkable was that when Mr. Tillerson left the Kremlin and held a news conference with Mr. Lavrov, they described completely different worlds.
sentences.zh: 引人注目的是，当蒂勒森先生离开克里姆林宫并与拉夫罗夫先生举行新闻发布会时，他们描述的是完全不同的世界。

sentences.en: Lavrov said, we need an investigation into what possibly might have caused this chemical weapons attack.
sentences.zh: 拉夫罗夫说，我们需要对可能导致这次化学武器袭击的原因进行调查。

sentences.en: The perspective from the United States, supported by the facts that we have, are conclusive.
sentences.zh: 而美国的观点，在我们的事实支持下，是确凿无疑的。

sentences.en: Tillerson said, we know what causes.
sentences.zh: 蒂勒森说，我们知道原因。

sentences.en: That the recent chemical weapons attack carried out in Syria was planned, and it was directed and executed by Syrian regime forces.
sentences.zh: 最近在叙利亚实施的化学武器袭击是由叙利亚政权军队策划、指挥和执行的。

sentences.en: From a Syrian base at which you, Mr. Lavrov, have roughly 100 Russian troops.
sentences.zh: 来自一个拉夫罗夫先生你驻扎了大约100名俄罗斯军队的叙利亚基地。

sentences.en: And we're quite confident of that.
sentences.zh: 我们对此非常有信心。

sentences.en: How could you have not known that they were taking off with chemical weapons?
sentences.zh: 你怎么可能不知道他们带着化学武器起飞了呢？

sentences.en: David, was this a tense exchange between the two of them?
sentences.zh: 大卫，他们两人之间的交流紧张吗？

sentences.en: It was clearly a bit tense.
sentences.zh: 显然有点紧张。

sentences.en: Tillerson is the opposite of John Kerry, quite terse.
sentences.zh: 蒂勒森与约翰·克里截然不同，非常简短。

sentences.en: Lavrov, on the other hand, he goes off at great length, and he decided that the moment had come to give a bit of a lecture about what had gone wrong in the American attempts
sentences.zh: 另一方面，拉夫罗夫滔滔不绝，他决定是时候就美国在世界各地试图改变政权时所犯的错误进行一番说教了。

sentences.en: to change regimes around the world.
sentences.zh: 改变政权时所犯的错误进行一番说教了。

sentences.en: And he said, in each of these cases, what you went into with whatever best intentions turned into a complete and utter mess.
sentences.zh: 他说，在每一个案例中，你们怀着最好的意图介入，结果却变成了一团糟。

sentences.en: And so when you tell us that you want to get rid of Assad, all we think of is, because you've done this so well before.
sentences.zh: 所以当你告诉我们你想除掉阿萨德时，我们想到的只是，因为你们以前把这事做得太好了。

sentences.en: So this fixation on trying to oust this or that dictator, an authoritarian or totalitarian
sentences.zh: 所以这种试图推翻这个或那个独裁者、威权或极权领导人的执念，我们很清楚，我们知道结局如何，

sentences.en: leader, as well known to us, and we know how it ends, a successful ouster of a dictator
sentences.zh: 推翻独裁者成功的例子，对我来说，很难想起。

sentences.en: is, for me, very hard to remember.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何例子，我很乐意你与我分享。

sentences.en: If you have any examples, I'd be glad if you could share them with me.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何例子，我很乐意你与我分享。

sentences.en: And you know what?
sentences.zh: 你知道吗？

sentences.en: When you're sitting there, and even when you've covered it, it's not a bad argument.
sentences.zh: 当你坐在那里，甚至当你报道过这些事情时，这并不是一个糟糕的论点。

sentences.en: Our record is not fabulous.
sentences.zh: 我们的记录并不光彩。

sentences.en: I mean, David, given the fact that you're describing two people that seem to be inhabiting alternate realities, even though they're in the same rooms in Moscow, where exactly does
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，大卫，鉴于你描述的两个人似乎生活在不同的现实中，尽管他们身处莫斯科的同一个房间里，这到底让我们处于什么境地？

sentences.en: it leave us?
sentences.zh: 这到底让我们处于什么境地？

sentences.en: Well, it leaves us in some places we didn't expect to be.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这让我们处于一些我们没预料到的境地。

sentences.en: If you had listened to Donald Trump...
sentences.zh: 如果你听过唐纳德·特朗普……

sentences.en: I would treat Vladimir Putin...
sentences.zh: 我会坚定地对待弗拉基米尔·普京……

sentences.en: ...on the campaign trail.
sentences.zh: ……在竞选活动中说的。

sentences.en: ...firmly.
sentences.zh: ……坚定地。

sentences.en: But there's nothing I can think of that I'd rather do than have Russia friendly, as opposed to the way they are right now, so that we can go and knock out ISIS together with other
sentences.zh: 但我想不出有什么比让俄罗斯变得友好更让我愿意做的事了，而不是像现在这样，这样我们就可以和其他人、其他国家一起去消灭ISIS。

sentences.en: people and with other countries.
sentences.zh: 和其他国家一起去消灭ISIS。

sentences.en: Wouldn't it be nice if we actually got along with people?
sentences.zh: 如果我们真的能和睦相处，那该多好？

sentences.en: Wouldn't it be nice if we actually got along, as an example, with Russia?
sentences.zh: 如果我们真的能和睦相处，比如和俄罗斯，那该多好？

sentences.en: I'm all for it.
sentences.zh: 我完全支持。

sentences.en: In about a week and a half, that has all disappeared.
sentences.zh: 在大约一周半的时间里，这一切都消失了。

sentences.en: What we have seen, I think, is the United States and Russia going back to the kind of contentious relationship it had in the Obama years.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们所看到的是，美国和俄罗斯回到了奥巴马时期那种充满争议的关系。

sentences.en: And whether Donald Trump can work that out, I do not know.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普能否解决这个问题，我不知道。

sentences.en: David, you interviewed Trump many times as a candidate about foreign policy, and I get the distinct sense that you felt he was far more comfortable thinking about the U.S.
sentences.zh: 大卫，你作为候选人多次采访过特朗普关于外交政策的问题，我有一种明显的感觉，你觉得他在思考美国经济和国内问题时要自在得多。

sentences.en: economy and domestic issues.
sentences.zh: 经济和国内问题时要自在得多。

sentences.en: And so now that you've watched this change in his engagement and even some of his positions about Russia, about whether to deal with Syria, is he becoming more comfortable, more
sentences.zh: 所以现在你观察到了他在参与度甚至在俄罗斯、叙利亚问题上的一些立场变化，他是否变得更自在、更自信、更投入了？

sentences.en: confident, more just engaged with all this?
sentences.zh: 他是否变得更自在、更自信、更投入了？

sentences.en: And is that meaningful?
sentences.zh: 这有意义吗？

sentences.en: Well, he's certainly becoming more engaged with it.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他当然变得更投入了。

sentences.en: And I think like all presidents, he will find it both fascinating and the one area where he can operate alone.
sentences.zh: 我认为像所有总统一样，他会发现这既令人着迷，又是他可以独自行动的唯一领域。

sentences.en: Remember, he had come out of months of significant frustration.
sentences.zh: 记住，他刚刚经历了几个月的巨大挫折。

sentences.en: He had an immigration effort that the court stymied.
sentences.zh: 他的移民政策努力被法院阻挠了。

sentences.en: He had a plan to replace Obamacare that Congress stymied.
sentences.zh: 他取代奥巴马医改的计划被国会阻挠了。

sentences.en: He is nowhere right now on his tax plan.
sentences.zh: 他的税收计划目前毫无进展。

sentences.en: And suddenly, along comes the Syria crisis, and he discovers, hey, with a single order, I can launch missiles all by myself.
sentences.zh: 突然间，叙利亚危机来了，他发现，嘿，只要一道命令，我就能独自发射导弹。

sentences.en: And you can.
sentences.zh: 你确实可以。
